headline: Memo600 Disses Jammy The Bull (OTF Jam) on Instagram
body: DJ Akademiks shared an Instagram post confirming that Memo600 has publicly dissed rapper Jammy The Bull, also known as OTF Jam. The post, published on September 9, 2026, received 3,326 likes and 423 comments. This update comes amid growing tension between the artists in the underground hip-hop scene. Akademiks' post serves as the latest development in the ongoing beef between these two figures.
